40k 11th edition: faction balance

Strike Force (2000 pts) games from 19 June to 25 October: 134,032 matches from 3,479 events, 72,455 lists. The first player scores 51.2%.

What changed since the last report

This is the first edition. From the next update, new data, score rate moves and rank changes are listed here.

Summary

Units

The median faction has 6 units in at least half of its lists and 27 in at least 10%. 17% of current datasheets (198 of 1,140) were never played or appeared in under 1% of lists. Of 1,178 units in 40 or more lists, 121 (10%) have a clear effect on results, 57 positive and 64 negative. Those units are picked about as often as others: the median share of lists is 16%, against 16% for all units.

Detachments

The median faction needs 5 detachments to cover 80% of its lists, and 10 factions have one detachment in at least half of its lists. Of 196 detachments in 150 or more lists, 47 (24%) differ from their own faction's average. That is a higher share than for units (10%) or combinations (16%), so detachment choice is the largest source of imbalance inside a faction.

Combinations

59% of lists run two or more detachments. Of 370 combinations in 15 or more lists, 61 differ from the faction average (27 better, 34 worse). The strongest is Assault Brethren + Deathwatch Support + Terminator Storm Force in Space Marines (19.9 points above the faction average), the weakest Dark Age Arsenal + Inner Circle Task Force in Dark Angels (25.0 points below the faction average).

Time and milestones

9 factions of 28 have a clearly different score rate in the latest period than in the first. The largest shifts follow "Codex: Space Marines (11th Edition) releases" (3 October): Space Marines +5.6 points, World Eaters +5.4 points, Thousand Sons -7.7 points, Necrons -4.6 points and Blood Angels +6.4 points. Other milestones followed by large moves: "July balance & rules update" (Dark Angels +6.0 points and Imperial Knights -5.6 points); "August balance & rules update" (Chaos Daemons -5.4 points). 36% of detachments and 25% of units (with 25 or more lists) changed their share of lists by at least 8 points, with a clear margin, between the first period and the last 28 days. That is a larger share than the 32% of factions whose score rate moved. Each faction section lists the biggest changes.

Milestones

Data starts at the 11th edition launch on 20 June and runs to 25 October. Weekly games went from 11,942 in the first full week to 20,254 in the week of 21 September. 5 milestones are marked below. Effects are measured as the 28 days before against the 28 days after each date.

How to read the tables

Space Marines codex and Power Armour update (3 October) had the widest effect: 7 factions changed score rate clearly, and 293 detachments, units and enhancements shifted by at least 8 points in their faction's lists. The last three columns count items that moved by at least 8 points of their faction's lists with a clear margin.

July balance & rules update (22 July)

3 factions changed score rate in the 28 days after: Dark Angels +6.0 points (47.8% to 53.8%), Imperial Knights -5.6 points (52.5% to 47.0%) and Thousand Sons -5.2 points (56.8% to 51.6%).

Force Disposition choice changed: Priority Assets went from 11.0% to 26.7% of games, Take and Hold went from 13.7% to 28.4% of games and Reconnaissance went from 8.1% to 15.7% of games.

30 detachments shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Veiled Blade Elimination Force in Imperial Agents (3% to 92%), Hexwarp Thrallband in Thousand Sons (55% to 11%) and Advanced Acquisition Cadre in T'au Empire (49% to 12%).

50 units shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Lieutenant with Combi-weapon in Deathwatch (54% to 16%), Intercessor Squad in Deathwatch (71% to 35%) and Lion El’jonson in Dark Angels (37% to 66%).

34 enhancements shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Eldritch Vortex of E'Taph in Thousand Sons (12% to 42%), The Tome of Ectoclades in Deathwatch (42% to 73%) and Umbralefic Crystal in Thousand Sons (13% to 43%).

Nothing clear in the first-turn effect.

August balance & rules update (26 August)

2 factions changed score rate in the 28 days after: Chaos Daemons -5.4 points (59.1% to 53.7%) and Necrons +3.7 points (49.8% to 53.6%).

16 detachments shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Might of the Moritoi in Adeptus Custodes (57% to 18%), Freebooter Krew in Orks (39% to 11%) and Hunting Warpack in Chaos Knights (26% to 52%).

55 units shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Painboy in Orks (67% to 30%), Wazdakka Gutsmek in Orks (70% to 36%) and Boyz in Orks (80% to 48%).

16 enhancements shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Dreadherder in Orks (0% to 21%), Snarling Rivalry in Chaos Knights (18% to 37%) and Supa-snazz Dakka in Orks (0% to 17%).

The 28 days after it also contain the milestone on 5 September, so the two effects overlap. Nothing clear in the first-turn effect and Force Disposition choice.

Orks codex (5 September)

59 units shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Painboy in Orks (67% to 18%), Boyz in Orks (79% to 37%) and Wazdakka Gutsmek in Orks (68% to 28%).

Space Marines codex and Power Armour update (3 October)

Space Marines, whose codex this was, went from 45.3% to 51.0% and from 6.3% to 9.0% of games.

7 factions changed score rate in the 28 days after: Space Marines +5.6 points (45.3% to 51.0%), World Eaters +5.4 points (49.1% to 54.4%), Thousand Sons -7.7 points (47.9% to 40.2%), Necrons -4.6 points (53.0% to 48.5%), Blood Angels +6.4 points (41.7% to 48.1%) and Adeptus Custodes -4.0 points (56.8% to 52.8%), and 1 more.

Force Disposition choice changed: Purge the Foe went from 19.8% to 23.4% of games.

65 detachments shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Legends of Saga and Song in Space Wolves (72% to 5%), Lords of the Forge in Adeptus Mechanicus (76% to 27%) and Assault Brethren in Blood Angels (0% to 49%).

175 units shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Bjorn The Fell-handed in Space Wolves (88% to 29%), Azrael in Dark Angels (83% to 38%) and Arjac Rockfist in Space Wolves (75% to 32%).

53 enhancements shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Furious Assault in Blood Angels (0% to 57%), Thief of Secrets in Deathwatch (60% to 4%) and Furious Assault in Black Templars (1% to 48%).

Only 23 days of data follow it, so the picture is still forming. The 28 days after it also contain the milestone on 17 October, so the two effects overlap. Nothing clear in the first-turn effect.

Adeptus Custodes codex (17 October)

Adeptus Custodes, whose codex this was, went from 54.9% to 52.1% and from 6.4% to 7.0% of games.

One faction changed score rate in the 28 days after: Space Marines +5.1 points (47.3% to 52.3%).

Force Disposition choice changed: Take and Hold went from 29.3% to 33.1% of games.

54 detachments shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Assault Brethren in Blood Angels (2% to 77%), Assault Brethren in Black Templars (1% to 69%) and Assault Brethren in Space Wolves (2% to 54%).

119 units shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Prosecutor Squad in Adeptus Custodes (1% to 58%), Witchseeker Squad in Adeptus Custodes (0% to 53%) and Eradicator Squad with Melta Rifles in Space Marines (8% to 60%).

38 enhancements shifted by at least 8 points of their faction's lists. Largest: Furious Assault in Blood Angels (17% to 62%), Augury Uplink (one per army) in Adeptus Custodes (0% to 44%) and Martial Signatum Amplificator in Adeptus Mechanicus (15% to 53%).

Only 9 days of data follow it, so the picture is still forming. Nothing clear in the first-turn effect.

Results brackets

Results come from 484 individual Strike Force events with at least 5 rounds: 7,418 lists entered and 5,900 played every round. Players are placed in five bands by the share of their games won. X is the most wins anyone had in the event, so X, X-1 and X-2 mean the same thing in a 5-round and a 7-round event: 918 lists won X, 1,329 won X-1 and 1,731 won X-2.

Players of Adeptus Custodes (49%), Orks (47%) and Necrons (43%) won at least 60% of their games more often than the field (35%). Players of Astra Militarum (20%) did so less often.

How to read the tables

Emperor's Children, Chaos Knights, Adeptus Custodes, Leagues of Votann and Grey Knights play from the smallest pool of units (effective unit count 16 to 19), while Space Marines, Astra Militarum and Aeldari have the widest (68 for the broadest). Across factions the correlation between effective unit count and score rate is -0.17. The narrowest factions include both strong and weak ones.

In 10 factions a single detachment is in at least half of all lists: Imperial Agents (Veiled Blade Elimination Force, 79%), Deathwatch (Black Spear Task Force, 78%), Drukhari (Exhibition of Slaughter, 66%), Genestealer Cult (Xenocult Masses, 62%), Adeptus Mechanicus (Lords of the Forge, 61%), Leagues of Votann (Hearthguard Covenant, 60%), Adeptus Custodes (Lions of the Emperor, 60%), World Eaters (Berzerker Warband, 57%), Space Wolves (Saga of the Great Wolf, 53%) and Grey Knights (Argent Assault, 50%).

18 of 1,140 current datasheets never appeared in a Strike Force list, and 180 more appeared in under 1% of their faction's lists. The factions with the most unused datasheets: Genestealer Cult (0 never, 38 rare), Chaos Daemons (0 never, 19 rare), Aeldari (4 never, 12 rare) and Astra Militarum (3 never, 9 rare).

How to read the tables

Player base

Dropping each faction's three most active players changes its score rate by less than 1 point in 26 of 28 factions. The exceptions are Imperial Agents (-2.1 points, five most active players = 16% of games) and Deathwatch (-1.6 points, five most active players = 10% of games). The skill proxy (each player's results at their other events) differs little between factions, from -1.5 to +1.2 points, so player track record does not explain the ranking.

Method

Data

268,064 player-game rows (134,032 matches) from 3,479 events in Strike Force (2000 pts) format. Mirror matches count once and draws count 0.5. The data holds 72,455 lists from 28 factions.

Effects

Each game result is compared with a prediction from the two factions' strength and the first-turn effect. A list's effect is its average result minus that prediction. Item effects (units, detachments, combinations, enhancements, Force Disposition) are group averages of these list results, with standard errors clustered by list. Detachment effects are measured against the faction average. Combination effects include the strength of the detachments in them. Enhancement effects are measured against other lists with the same detachment. Unit effects are measured against lists with the same detachment strength and the same number of distinct units. Shrinkage towards the faction mean is used only to rank noisy items.

An effect is called clear when it is at least 3 standard errors from zero. Across roughly 3,000 items tested, a handful of clear results will still be chance, so a single borderline item should be read with care. Items in fewer than 15 to 40 lists, depending on the table, are left out.

Player track record

Each player's average result at their other events (leave-one-event-out, shrunk towards zero) is subtracted. About 74% of games have such a history. Players with a single event get no adjustment.

Parse completeness

The parser reads the unit points of nearly every list: the average sum of parsed unit points is about 1,990 of 2,000, and 97.6% of lists reach 1,950 or more. Lists with fewer parsed points score differently by up to about 7 points between the lowest and highest groups, and results were adjusted for this before items were compared. The list-width table uses only lists with at least 1,850 parsed points. Pick rates are shares of all lists in the faction. Faction, matchup and detachment results are not affected (detachment effects correlate 1.00 with the unadjusted values).

Limits

Results show what happens in tournaments. Players choose what to bring, and those choices follow skill, preparation and the opponents they expect. Points and rules changed during the period, and milestones fall close together, so a change after a milestone does not prove a single cause. Effects are associations. Small factions such as Deathwatch and Imperial Agents have wide uncertainty throughout, and milestones with fewer than 14 days of data (Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11th Edition) releases (17 Oct), 9 days of data) cannot yet be judged.

Results brackets use event standings from individual Strike Force events with at least 5 rounds only, a much smaller set than the game-level analysis. Swiss pairing makes players with equal records meet, which compresses records, and strong players choose strong factions, so brackets reflect players as well as factions. Lists that did not play every round count as entries for X to X-2 but not for the win bands.

How to read the tables

Score rate
A win counts 1 and a draw 0.5. The 95% CI is the interval the true score rate lies in with 95% confidence.
Effect (pp)
The difference in score rate, in percentage points, between lists that include an item and comparable lists of the same faction, after allowing for opponent strength, the first-turn effect and the player's track record. The figure after the sign is one standard error.
z
The effect divided by its standard error. Values of 3 or more in either direction are called clear and coloured: blue for better, orange for worse.
Model expects, Diff (pp), Reading
Model expects is the score predicted from both factions' strength and the first-turn effect. Diff is the gap between the actual score and that prediction. Reading is shown when the interval excludes 50% or the gap to the model is clear after multiple-testing control.
Lists, Pick, In % of lists
The number of lists containing the item and their share of the faction's lists. A list with two detachments counts for both.
P1 to P4
The share of the faction's lists that include the detachment in each period. The period dates are given in the Over time table of each faction.
Milestone table
Score rate and share of games in the 28 days before and after the milestone. Changes with z of 3 or more are coloured.
Effective units
The number of equally common units that would give the same spread of play; higher means more varied. It can exceed a faction's own datasheet count because lists also contain units from outside the faction's codex.
Avg list overlap
The average share of units two random lists of the faction have in common.
Results brackets
Win bands place each player by the share of games won (a draw counts half) among players who played every round. X is the most wins in the event; X, X-1 and X-2 count the lists with that many wins. Share of tier is the faction's share of the lists in that tier, share of entries its share of all lists entered, and ratio the first divided by the second.
Top-10% ratio
The faction's share of top-10% finishes divided by its share of entrants.
Pick-rate shifts
Share of the faction's lists that include the item in the first period, the 28 days before the last 28, and the last 28 days. Only changes of 4 or more standard errors and a sizeable gap are listed.

Dark Angels

53.5%score rate, rank 4 of 2811,380 games3,240 lists from 1,900 playerstop-10% finishes 1.34x entry sharegoing first 1.8 points better

Dark Angels climbed from 47.8% in the first period (19 Jun to 21 Jul) to 54.2% in the latest (3 Oct to 25 Oct), one of 9 factions with a clear change over the period. Redemptor Dreadnought is in 8% of lists, and lists with it score 7.5 points below comparable lists. The season figure is 53.5% (rank 4 of 28, 11,380 games), which understates where it stands now. Company of Hunters went from 51% to 6% of the faction's lists over the last 28 days compared with the 28 before. Stormlance Task Force lists score 8.8 points above the faction average and make up 5% of the faction's lists.

Necrons

51.4%score rate, rank 8 of 2815,739 games4,487 lists from 2,646 playerstop-10% finishes 1.05x entry sharegoing first 1.6 points better

Canoptek Doomstalker is in 7% of lists, and lists with it score 8.5 points below comparable lists. Hand of the Dynasty lists score 5.7 points below the faction average and make up 18% of the faction's lists. Necrons scores 51.4% over 15,739 games, rank 8 of 28. Skyshroud Spearhead went from 24% to 34% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. The pairing Cursed Legion + Hand of the Dynasty scores 9.7 points below the faction average (216 lists).

Units

A typical list contains 12 distinct units. 5 units appear in at least half of all lists and 32 in at least 10%. The most common is Ophydian Destroyers (63% of lists). 4 datasheets appeared in under 1% of lists: Canoptek Macrocytes, Convergence Of Dominion, Seraptek Heavy Construct, Trazyn The Infinite.

Of 48 units in 40 or more lists, 9 have a clear effect on results (4 positive, 5 negative). Best: Canoptek Tomb Crawlers (5.3 points above comparable lists, 10% of lists), Nekrosor Ammentar (2.1 points above comparable lists, 58% of lists), Lokhust Destroyers (1.9 points above comparable lists, 44% of lists) and Lokhust Lord (1.6 points above comparable lists, 46% of lists). Weakest: Canoptek Doomstalker (8.5 points below comparable lists, 7% of lists), Chronomancer (4.4 points below comparable lists, 9% of lists), Necron Warriors (3.5 points below comparable lists, 26% of lists) and Immortals (3.3 points below comparable lists, 26% of lists). Necron Warriors, Immortals and Doomsday Ark are in at least 15% of lists but score below it.

Emperor's Children

51.3%score rate, rank 9 of 2810,781 games2,983 lists from 1,762 playerstop-10% finishes 1.03x entry sharegoing first 2.4 points better

The Euphoric Crown enhancement scores 9.4 points below other lists with the same detachment. Spectacle of Slaughter lists score 4.7 points below the faction average and make up 21% of the faction's lists. Emperor's Children scores 51.3% over 10,781 games, rank 9 of 28. Lucius the Eternal went from 43% to 78% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. The pairing Frenzied Host + Peerless Bladesmen scores 10.3 points below the faction average (87 lists).

Adeptus Mechanicus

50.4%score rate, rank 10 of 285,903 games1,607 lists from 948 playerstop-10% finishes 1.01x entry sharegoing first 3.1 points better

Haloscreed Battle Clade lists score 10.9 points below the faction average and make up 10% of the faction's lists. Adeptus Mechanicus climbed from 45.4% in the first period (19 Jun to 21 Jul) to 55.6% in the latest (3 Oct to 25 Oct), one of 9 factions with a clear change over the period. The season figure is 50.4% (rank 10 of 28, 5,903 games), which understates where it stands now. Cohort Cybernetica went from 25% to 77% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. The pairing Cohort Cybernetica + Eradication Cohort scores 10.0 points above the faction average (166 lists).

Thousand Sons

50.3%score rate, rank 11 of 288,420 games2,336 lists from 1,401 playerstop-10% finishes 1.29x entry sharegoing first 5.9 points better

Thousand Sons fell from 56.9% in the first period (19 Jun to 21 Jul) to 40.5% in the latest (3 Oct to 25 Oct), one of 9 factions with a clear change over the period. The pairing Hexwarp Thrallband + Sekhetar Cohort scores 14.1 points above the faction average (170 lists). The season figure is 50.3% (rank 11 of 28, 8,420 games), which overstates where it stands now. Hexwarp Thrallband went from 52% to 4% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. Sekhetar Cohort lists score 6.7 points above the faction average and make up 17% of the faction's lists.

World Eaters

49.9%score rate, rank 13 of 2810,836 games3,133 lists from 1,895 playerstop-10% finishes 0.78x entry sharegoing first 0.8 points better

World Eaters climbed from 44.6% in the first period (19 Jun to 21 Jul) to 54.4% in the latest (3 Oct to 25 Oct), one of 9 factions with a clear change over the period. Berzerker Warband lists score 2.5 points above the faction average and make up 57% of the faction's lists. The season figure is 49.9% (rank 13 of 28, 10,836 games), which understates where it stands now. Vessels of Wrath went from 12% to 45% of the faction's lists over the last 28 days compared with the 28 before. The pairing Butchers of Khorne + Possessed Slaughterband scores 13.9 points below the faction average (37 lists).

Imperial Knights

48.5%score rate, rank 16 of 289,989 games2,757 lists from 1,676 playerstop-10% finishes 0.78x entry sharegoing first 1.8 points better

Against Tyranids it scores 58.7% over 578 games, 10.1 points above what its strength predicts. Imperial Knights fell from 52.9% in the first period (19 Jun to 21 Jul) to 46.5% in the latest (3 Oct to 25 Oct), one of 9 factions with a clear change over the period. The season figure is 48.5% (rank 16 of 28, 9,989 games), which overstates where it stands now. Gate Warden Lance went from 43% to 8% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. The Hunter's Eye enhancement scores 2.9 points above other lists with the same detachment.

Grey Knights

46.9%score rate, rank 21 of 286,403 games1,781 lists from 1,046 playerstop-10% finishes 0.75x entry sharegoing first 5.0 points worse

Going first is worth 5.0 points to Grey Knights (44.7% against 49.7%), below the field's 2.4 points. The Predestined Coordinates enhancement scores 15.9 points below other lists with the same detachment. Grey Knights scores 46.9% over 6,403 games, rank 21 of 28. Warpbane Task Force went from 18% to 42% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. The pairing Argent Assault + Augurium Task Force scores 23.5 points below the faction average (16 lists).

Chaos Space Marines

46.8%score rate, rank 22 of 2811,342 games3,210 lists from 2,038 playerstop-10% finishes 0.86x entry sharegoing first 2.8 points better

Chaos Space Marines fell from 51.3% in the first period (19 Jun to 21 Jul) to 45.3% in the latest (3 Oct to 25 Oct), one of 9 factions with a clear change over the period. The pairing Cabal of Chaos + Nightmare Hunt scores 16.8 points below the faction average (57 lists). The season figure is 46.8% (rank 22 of 28, 11,342 games), which overstates where it stands now. Mutilators went from 12% to 48% of the faction's lists between the first period and the last 28 days. The Eye of Tzeentch enhancement scores 19.0 points below other lists with the same detachment.

Units

A typical list contains 11 distinct units. 3 units appear in at least half of all lists and 36 in at least 10%. The most common is Cultist Mob (88% of lists). 3 datasheets never appeared: Cultist Mob with Firearms, Reaver Titan, Rogue Psyker. One datasheet appeared in under 1% of lists: Khorne Berzerkers.

Of 57 units in 40 or more lists, 19 have a clear effect on results (5 positive, 14 negative). Best: Masters of the Maelstrom (4.8 points above comparable lists, 41% of lists), Cypher (3.9 points above comparable lists, 21% of lists), Huron Blackheart (3.2 points above comparable lists, 36% of lists) and Chaos Bikers (3.2 points above comparable lists, 35% of lists). Weakest: Khorne Lord Of Skulls (11.3 points below comparable lists, 2% of lists), Sorcerer (7.6 points below comparable lists, 6% of lists), Havocs (7.5 points below comparable lists, 14% of lists) and Chaos Predator Annihilator (7.5 points below comparable lists, 5% of lists). Beasts Of Nurgle is in under 10% of lists but scores above the faction average. Forgefiend, Obliterators, Warp Talons and Chaos Lord are in at least 15% of lists but score below it.
